customManagers.description: Update the Renovate image tag and digest together in both workflows
matchStrings: # renovate-image: tracked by the dedicated regex manager in \.github/renovate\.json\s+RENOVATEBOT_VERSION: \"(?<currentValue>[^@\"]+)@(?<currentDigest>sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})\"

customManagers.description: Update the OWASP ZAP scanner image tag and digest together in dast.yml
matchStrings: # zap-image: tracked by the dedicated regex manager in \.github/renovate\.json\s+ZAP_VERSION: \"(?<currentValue>[^@\"]+)@(?<currentDigest>sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})\"

packageRules.description: Automerge patch, pin, and digest updates after required CI checks pass and a 3-day soak window
Minor updates require manual review; hold 3 days to catch immediate regressions
Delay major updates so the ecosystem (Expo SDK, jest-expo, msw, babel presets) can add support first; never automerge majors
Keep npm overrides exact so npm lockfile updates do not fail with EOVERRIDE
OWASP ZAP scanner image: follow numbered releases only, not the weekly/nightly/stable/bare tags
Keep fast-uri on the compatible 3.x release line

Mobile overrides are pinned to CommonJS-compatible releases of what their consumers require (checked on Expo SDK 58): uuid for xcode (^7) and nanoid for @react-navigation/routers and postcss (^3). uuid 14 and nanoid 6 are ESM-only (nanoid 6 breaks the navigator Jest suites). Revisit when those consumers move, not with the Expo SDK. The nested js-yaml override for @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config is not listed: js-yaml 5 ships a CommonJS build and that consumer only calls load().
Defer Node.js and npm major upgrades until the Expo SDK upgrade validates the native toolchain against the new runtime (mobile/.nvmrc and the workflow NODE_VERSION are pinned to 26).
Runner images are pinned deliberately (ubuntu-26.04) for reproducible native/CI behaviour; ubuntu-latest is migrated by GitHub itself. Do not auto-bump the runner major.
Exclude the native/runtime dependencies whose versions are pinned by the installed Expo SDK; these must move together with an SDK upgrade, never independently

Expo SDK packages (expo, expo-*, @expo/*): allow patch updates within the current SDK line, but block minor and major, which track SDK releases and require the native toolchain upgrade to be validated first
Keep React types aligned with React 19 in mobile
Expo's plist parser (@expo/plist 0.10, still on SDK 58) omits the MIME type required by @xmldom/xmldom 0.9
Keep Temurin runtime images on Java 25 (LTS)
Keep Alpine runtime images on the 3.24 release line
Keep PostgreSQL container images on version 18 to avoid incompatible data directory upgrades
Keep TypeScript on major version 6
Keep Vitest and its coverage provider on the Angular 22.2-compatible 5.x release line

Catch-all: batch patch/pin/digest updates of packages that no named group below matches into one automerged PR. Must stay above the named groups: later packageRules override earlier ones, so named groups win.

Catch-all: batch minor updates of packages that no named group below matches into one PR for manual review. Must stay above the named groups: later packageRules override earlier ones, so named groups win.
Update the Angular framework and its compatible toolchain together
Keep Tailwind CSS and PostCSS plugin aligned
Keep Zod aligned across web, mobile, and shared schemas
Keep the Spring Boot plugin and dependency BOM aligned
Flyway core and its PostgreSQL module must use the same release
Hibernate core and JCache integration are version-coupled
Keep the Netty BOM and explicit DNS codec pin aligned
Keep Log4j API and its SLF4J bridge on the same release
Keep Jackson 2 security pins and BOM aligned
Keep Jackson 3 security pins and BOM aligned
Keep Tomcat embedded dependencies aligned
Keep OpenTelemetry modules and semconv aligned
Keep Testcontainers modules aligned
Keep Byte Buddy modules aligned
Keep SLF4J modules aligned
React Navigation packages share React Native peer-dependency constraints
Keep native test tooling aligned with its React Native compatibility requirements

Pin third-party GitHub Actions to commit digests: CodeQL's security-extended actions/unpinned-tag rule flags mutable tag refs for non-GitHub actions, and only a digest prevents a retargeted tag from running with the workflow's credentials. GitHub-owned actions (actions/*, github/*) stay on tag refs. Renovate keeps each pin current from its '# vX.Y.Z' comment.
Group GitHub Actions updates

Blocked on Expo: babel-preset-expo (SDK 58 and canary) is built on Babel 7, so @babel/core 8 and babel-plugin-transform-import-meta 3 (requires Babel 8) cannot move. Fully suppressed: no branch, no PR, dashboard-only.

The Renovate image runs with RENOVATE_TOKEN: review every update, patches included. Its own group keeps it out of the automerged all-patch batch (one non-automerge member would hold that whole branch back). Must stay below the catch-all groups.
